item.title: ParaAir 0.1.0 alpha 3
item.description:
• A new app icon in the macOS 26 style.
  • When an update is ready, ParaAir says so in its menu bar panel and window instead of an alert that can open behind other apps.
  • Setup points to the switch that works: System Settings, Login Items & Extensions, By Category, File System Extensions.
  • Buttons match the size and shape of the macOS buttons beside them.
  • Installing from the disk image no longer leaves a stale copy registered with macOS.

item.title: ParaAir 0.1.0 alpha 2
item.description:
• ParaAir now updates itself. Before installing an update it ejects its drives; files waiting to upload stay on your Mac and upload afterwards.
  • Connect Cloudflare R2 with an R2 API token, from any Cloudflare account.
  • A new look that matches paraair.pages.dev, with clearer text in Light mode.
  • Opening ParaAir from the disk image moves it to Applications, and it opens at login.
  • The version, with its alpha number, is in Advanced and About ParaAir.
